description: 60 separate independent source-evidence and linguistic review packets; dictionary links are unvisited lookup destinations, not observed evidence.

english_definition_review.task: Independently observe exact POS and intended sense in a credible dictionary; record URL, date, quoted/paraphrased observed evidence and reviewer. A link alone is not evidence.

burmese_review.task: Independently check natural Myanmar meaning, register, grammar and exact sense equivalence; record reviewer and evidence.

example_review.task: Independently check sentence grammar, collocation, sense, readability and originality.

cefr_review.task: Find sense-specific CEFR evidence; re-tier or quarantine if provisional level unsupported.

audio_review.task: Only after text approval generate George/Emma audio; listen to each recording and test real iPhone Safari.
